newsitem.title: CANADA: StatsCan survey sees Oct unemployment at 9.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: StatsCan survey sees Oct unemployment at 9.8 pct.

text.p: A Statistics Canada survey of analysts forecast Canadian unemployment will show a slight drop to 9.8 percent in October from 9.9 percent in September.
The survey also forecast that consumer prices would register a rise in October of 1.5 pct from a year earlier.
The survey forecast gross domestic product to rise 0.3 percent in September from August.
The economists also forecast merchandise exports for September of C$23.1 billion, and imports of C$19.5 billion.
The agency on average surveys 17 economists each month.
